name: glyphs-mcp
description: Inspect and safely control open Glyphs fonts through the local Glyphs MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Review and control open Glyphs fonts from ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to the local Glyphs MCP plug-in for Knowledge-backed font work, generic reads, immutable previews, verified writes, save-tolerant history, and permanent Python fallback. Glyphs remains the editor.
defaultPrompt: Show the Glyphs MCP server identity and open-document status.
Read an exact glyph or layer and explain the evidence.
Preview an explicit spacing change without saving.
